subject: Web Development
title: jQuery: Write Less, Do More
description: A short lesson to help you apply jQuery: Write Less, Do More.

hook.text: In 2006, working with the DOM was painful. Every browser had different APIs.

buildup.text: John Resig created jQuery — a library that smoothed over all the browser differences.

discovery.text: One line of jQuery could replace twenty lines of raw JavaScript across all browsers.

twist.text: jQuery became so popular that beginners thought it WAS JavaScript. They couldn't tell apart.

climax.text: At its peak, jQuery ran on 75% of all websites. It was the web's universal toolkit.

punchline.text: One library unified a fragmented web.

quiz.question: What problem did jQuery mainly solve?
